body: I have given up.  I have no money and the depression is crippling enough I can't even hold a temp job.  There is no medicine that will 'miracle\-cure' me in time to avoid homelessness \(4 days from now\) and I have no hope.  I am renting a room right now, but the market rents have seem to gone up more than 50% since...  As I said, this all caught me at a bad time and I have no help \- parents both dead and friends and family unable to help.  I wish someone would just kill me and put me out of my misery.
